title: Placeholder capsule journeys to the summit
summary: Extend the M0 controller scaffold with the contact verbs M1 needs and prove a completable journey: a placeholder capsule runs, jumps, mantles, and climbs ledges and rungs to the summit and plants the flag, driven by the environment spec.
scope_out: stud/free/pole/overhang climb, slide, full landing tiers (M3)

acceptance_tests.test: On a corpus environment the capsule reaches the designated summit using run, jump, mantle, and ledge/rung climb, and plants the flag; the route it takes matches a validator-approved route.
Contact verbs (mantle, vault, hop-over, ledge hang/climb, rung climb) use motion warping to land on the real edges; all thresholds come from config/movement.json.
acceptance_tests.evidence: clip + grep showing no hard-coded constants

acceptance_tests.test: A scripted playthrough completes on 8 of 10 corpus environments with no manual fixes.
Holds the SPEC §6 targets on the reference iPhones.
